gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-blinker: Blinker reads friendly and tidy, its lines holding one thickness and its lowercase filling most of the height. Ethnocentric stretches wide above it, a fast display face cut from one gauge of tubing.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-carrois-gothi: Fast, wide and a bit aggressive, Ethnocentric spaces its letters far apart. Carrois Gothic follows with a high-set x-height and a generous opening in c, modern and sensible.

Carrois Gothic SC has a contemporary, approachable look, with clear openings at the end of every curve and capitals barely taller than lowercase. And Ethnocentric is the one for speed, spread wide and sharp, while the sans-serif text just stays easy to follow.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-chivo: Ethnocentric spreads its letters wide apart, with short ascenders sitting above big bowls and a fast, aggressive temper. Chivo does the quieter job, packing its lowercase up toward the caps with visible daylight in every curve.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-chocolate-cla: Loud, wide and quick, with a modern sans underneath. Chocolate Classical Sans brings a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, which is the pair's real hook.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-comme: Ethnocentric arrives fast and aggressive, its letters pushed apart and its curves smooth. Comme takes over below as a plain sans with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, so the heading may look best given generous size.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-cossette-text: Wide-set letters under short ascenders give Ethnocentric its fast, aggressive edge. Cossette Texte is the clean counterpart, with a prominent x-height and wide-eyed lowercase e shapes, drawn without any thick and thin contrast.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans reads clean and modern, with wide openings on small letters and bodies that dominate the line while ascenders hardly show. Ethnocentric is the one for speed and bite, and the sans simply carries the words.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-fresca: Fresca reads cleanly, with no calligraphic thinning and apertures that keep each counter connected to the space outside. The pair's strongest quality is stance: Ethnocentric charges, Fresca steadies.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-funnel-sans: Ethnocentric comes in fast and aggressive, with letters pushed apart and smooth, unclogged curves. And Funnel Sans keeps each stroke at the same visual weight, a plain sans that grounds the speed above.
